name: superpowers
description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
one_liner: A structured process that makes an AI coding assistant plan, get your sign-off, then build in small verified steps instead of guessing and rewriting code randomly.
buyer: A startup CTO who lets AI agents work autonomously for hours but has been burned by them going off-plan or shipping untested code, and wants a disciplined process baked in.
business_use_cases: A small dev shop adopts it as their default methodology so every AI-assisted client project follows the same spec-first, test-driven process.
A solo founder uses it to let an AI agent work unsupervised overnight on a feature, trusting the plan-then-build gate to prevent scope creep.
An enterprise pays for the project's own commercial support and managed-spending add-ons for teams running agents at scale.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid implementation-plan templates tuned for specific stacks (e.g. Rails, Next.js, mobile) that plug into the methodology.
Provide a hosted dashboard that visualizes and audits what autonomous agent sessions did against the approved plan, for engineering managers.

steal_this: Package a niche 'plan-and-build' skill preset for one specific framework (e.g. a Shopify app methodology) and give it away to build an audience, then sell a paid support tier.
